name: overleaf-template-updater
description: Keep Overleaf LaTeX templates up to date, and move a paper's front matter between venue templates.

scripts.test: node test/run.js && node test/run-unzip.js && node test/run-planner.js && node test/run-venue-shift.mjs
scripts.test:offline: node test/run.js && node test/run-unzip.js && node test/run-planner.js --offline && node test/run-venue-shift.mjs
